item.text:
Refactored the codebase to make graph-producing operations extensible, not just graph analyses.

The key additions are [GraphTransformation.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/031_articulation_points/GraphTransformation.java) and [GraphTransformations.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/031_articulation_points/GraphTransformations.java). `Graph` now has a `transform(...)` entry point in [Graph.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/031_articulation_points/Graph.java), and [GraphBuilder.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/031_articulation_points/GraphBuilder.java) now exposes `fromGraph(...)` as a stable cloning/derivation hook. That gives future features a shared contract for graph-to-graph operations, analogous to the existing `GraphAnalysis` contract for graph-to-result operations. I also added a reusable `filterEdges(...)` transformation utility and routed `copyBuilder()` through the new builder factory.

Verification passed with `javac *.java && java ArticulationPoints`, and the output remains `1 4`.
